statement: The recorded membership value is not safe or correct for this case because Tomas cancelled in writing on 3 July and Fitline confirmed the cancellation, so the renewal charge should be refused.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts "The recorded membership value is not safe or correct... Tomas cancelled in writing... so the renewal charge should be refused," naming the contradiction with the confirmed cancellation.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
